objective: Estimate extra carried box bottom-height error at taught placement attributable to a displaced pickup, prior to touchdown. Reconstruct measured link dynamics, use public known payload+COM, nominal robot and encoder/JTS. No fixture offsets, actual link or free-box state, table force, impact/alarms, or stiffness labels in inference or fitting.
window: Decision at 3.550s. Measured 41-point smooth quadratic-endpoint convolution of q/central velocity/acceleration, end +22ms. Lift [1.55,1.69] and free carry [1.84,3.51] every 8ms. Previous-step R12 physics: at state j use unfiltered elastic JTS j+1, rigid-axis average j+1/j+2; do not need future observations relative to decision. Filter dynamics differences against matched centre torque.
parameters: Linearize public inverse dynamics in three flange-referenced COM displacements (1.0mm symmetric probes) about a public pickup datum: nominal box pose and measured flange at suction onset. Separate nuisance column for inverse stiffness, estimated from measured q/encoder reconstruction (+/-5%); unknown per-joint affine sensor bias terms. Fit full motion, not a static gravity model.
normal_calibration: Five known zero-displacement training trials per mode. No measured box positions or simulator labels in model: fit per-phase/per-joint mean ID mismatch vs mass with intercept and slope. Normalize by per-joint training mismatch with public noise floor. Subtract this calibration from new public measurements; no fitting on displaced/impact cases. Empirical error guard uses leave-one-normal-out and fixed block deletion, not probabilistic coverage.
uncertainty: Report an envelope at least 0.75mm (pickup pose/systematic motion), plus the largest leave-one-calibration-out false vertical estimate, plus largest change dropping each of five interleaved 80ms block sets. Abstain if interval contains zero, half-width >2.5mm, extrapolated mass, |inferred shift|>15mm, ill-conditioned or nonfinite. No claims of formal confidence coverage.
scoring: Offline compute true bottom via rigid pose of free box relative to actual flange while airborne, projected to taught placement. Compare its CHANGE vs the same case's nominal pickup variant; also report absolute relative-to-ideal geometry and COM. A different physical pose at latch, tilt and weld/box motion are not the same as the configured offset. Do not use a matched zero run to infer a test case (score only).
gates: Per mode: all 8 nonzero-height cases correct sign incl abstentions as non-success, RMSE of operational estimates vs measured bottom delta <=2mm (report paired-difference RMSE separately), max magnitude on 4 zero and 4 lateral-only cases vs their respective truth <=2mm, all accepted estimates within declared intervals; >=6/8 confident vertical corrections, or do not connect to control. Normal control/detector untouched by recording. If passes, freeze then test active correction on new paired physical cases with complete R12 costs, G4 and collisions. If fails, a separate active-excitation arm may be evaluated but never fit on held truth.
variants: zero: no pickup offset, xy: displaced horizontally only, up/down: same horizontal displacement and opposite vertical translations. All seeds matched within group for evaluator-only differences. Test fixture settings never passed to estimate().
